1. Problem statement

Given three integers A, B, and C, find the largest number among them and print it.

If two or more numbers have the same maximum value, print that value.


2. Input format

A single line containing three space-separated integers A, B, and C.


3. Output format

Print a single integer representing the largest of the three numbers.


4. Constraints

-10^9 <= A, B, C <= 10^9
